title.en: Clean haircuts and satisfying grooming results

text.en: The majority of pet parents report tidy, well-executed haircuts and fresh-smelling baths for their dogs. Clients frequently express satisfaction with full-service styling, although one reviewer was disappointed when dark canine nails were buffed rather than clipped.

Several pet owners praise individual stylists by name for their warm customer service and helpful updates during appointments. Conversely, other visitors report unprofessional treatment and communication lapses, pointing to inconsistent staff demeanor in the salon.

While multiple reviewers commend stylists for putting nervous dogs at ease and sending reassuring progress messages, one owner reported a deeply distressing visit where a stylist appeared unsupportive of an anxious dog during a first-time grooming appointment.

q.en: What grooming treatments are offered at the Henry Avenue Petco salon?

a.en: The salon offers full-service dog baths, breed-specific haircuts, nail trimming and buffing, ear cleansing, and shed-release treatments.

q.en: Do stylists keep pet parents updated during appointments?

a.en: Many clients mention receiving regular phone updates and status notifications regarding their dog's grooming progress and pickup timing.

q.en: How are anxious or first-time grooming dogs accommodated?

a.en: Reviewers share mixed feedback; certain experienced stylists handle nervous pets gently, whereas other clients reported rigid salon handling policies.

q.en: Is online booking available for grooming appointments?

a.en: Yes, appointments can be reserved in advance through the Petco website or arranged directly by telephone with the salon desk.
